sources.section: Struct layout, software prefetch and page size
sources.entry: dwarves (pahole) - Prints a struct's holes, padding and cache-line boundaries from DWARF, so a layout is seen rather than guessed.

summary.one_liner: dwarves is a set of tools (including pahole) that read DWARF and BTF debugging information from compiled binaries and print or convert type and struct layouts.
summary.what_it_does: The README covers only build and test instructions, so the capabilities below come from the listing note rather than the README itself. The listing describes pahole as printing a struct's holes, padding and cache-line boundaries from DWARF data. The README says tests run against a vmlinux binary that must contain DWARF, which is converted to BTF. The README also notes that libbpf is a git submodule. It does not describe the individual tools or their command-line usage.
use_cases: inspect struct layout and padding in C programs
find holes and cache-line boundaries in structs
convert DWARF debug info to BTF
check struct layout of a kernel vmlinux binary
notable: Prints struct holes, padding and cache-line boundaries from DWARF data (per listing note)
Converts DWARF to BTF using a vmlinux binary with debug info
Supports shared or static library builds via CMake options
Test suite runnable locally or through GitHub Actions scripts
caveats: README covers build and test steps only; tool usage is not documented in it
Test runs need a vmlinux binary that contains DWARF information
Requires the libbpf git submodule to be initialized
